means: for every drawn route node a demo builds, which of the 5040 orders a 7-bag can deal let a player with one hold slot place the drawing's pieces in an order the engine can build, on the board the node's demo parent leaves
not_eligible_because: which placements are reachable is one engine's (Cold Clear corroborates the cells of each edge, never its spin); the hold combinatorics are proved, the edges are not

rules.orders: lexicographic permutations of the piece indices of IOTSZJL; accepted bit j = order j, LSB first in each byte, hex
rules.stream: the bag's 7 pieces, then one next-bag piece that may enter the hold and is never placed
rules.moves: place the current piece; or swap with the held piece and place it; or, hold empty, hold the current piece and place the next
rules.edges: [subset, group]: the engine reaches the group's cells on the subset's board with the planner's spin, uLast, uFiresBefore and line-count rules; the page's order conditions are NOT edges
rules.partial_bag: a drawing with fewer than 7 groups is the bag's first k placements
rules.modes: empty: the bag starts with an empty hold; next: with its first piece already held (theorem T4: the same orders)
